title: Coefficient/exponent pair (2, 1) for the threshold-two family by self-contained gate elimination

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total threshold-two family defined in proof.md: for every n>=0, f_n(x)=1 exactly when x in {0,1}^n has at least two 1-bits (so f_0=f_1=0). One linear-time evaluator decides it at every length; the NP verifier accepts exactly the empty witness on accepted inputs, with witness bound zero.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"2"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li\u2013Yang B2 model; hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n).","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
